summary: Lewis Hamilton seeks redemption at Circuit of the Americas after a costly Singapore miscalculation hands rival Kimi Antonelli the chance to clinch the world championship this weekend. McLaren's tactical prowess will face its sternest test as the team juggles damage control for Hamilton while protecting Antonelli's title push against Ferrari's desperate counterattack. A victory for Antonelli in Austin would seal his maiden world championship, while a Hamilton win becomes essential to keep the fight alive and erase the sting of his strategic blunder.
